works: Aristoteles von der Zeugung und Entwicklung der Thiere, Lpz 1860
A.rule: TAKES A WORK SIGLUM. Bonitz: 'litterae A ubi opus erat additum est siglum eius libri Aristotelici, ad quem pertinet horum interpretum adnotatio, veluti AΖι i e Aub ad Ζι.' So AΖι is A + Ζι (Historia animalium) and AΖγ is A + Ζγ (De gen. an.) — NOT 'AZ' plus a book letter.

Bk.note: the Academy edition text itself; Bk2 and Bk3 are his second and third editions of some books

Ar über die Theile der Thiere; Ar Naturgeschichte der Thiere, Stuttgart 1855, 1866
Ka.rule: ALSO TAKES A WORK SIGLUM: 'alter liber ab altero distinguitur siglis KΖμ. KΖι.'
